mapper.select: SELECT badge_code FROM user_badge WHERE user_code = #{userCode}::uuid
SELECT badge_code AS badgeCode, earned_at AS earnedAt, is_viewed AS viewed FROM user_badge WHERE user_code = #{userCode}::uuid ORDER BY earned_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_badge (user_code, badge_code) VALUES (#{userCode}::uuid, #{badgeCode}) ON CONFLICT (user_code, badge_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE user_badge SET is_viewed = TRUE WHERE user_code = #{userCode}::uuid AND badge_code = #{badgeCode}
